facts.business: Shadowfax Technologies Limited operates a technology-led third-party logistics platform providing express delivery, hyperlocal delivery, reverse logistics, and exchange-as-a-service for e-commerce, quick commerce, D2C brands, and SMEs across India.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Target 17,000 pin codes by FY27, full national coverage by FY28

capacity_or_capex.item: Dark Stores for Vertical Quick Commerce
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Setting up 100 dark stores in FY27

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expand pin code coverage from 15,656 to 17,000 by FY27 and achieve full national coverage by FY28
Set up 100 dark stores to power vertical quick commerce

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to manual inputs and computations from system-generated reports
High volume of operational data processed through IT systems with manual revenue determination
Dependence on gig-based crowdsourced delivery network
Competition in 3PL express and quick commerce logistics
Execution risk in deploying IPO proceeds across sortation centres, dark stores, and pin code expansion
